blocks.value: You can store values now. Operators are how you *do* something with them, add a score, compare two grades, check whether a user is both logged in and an admin.
Most of this lesson will feel like arithmetic you already know. Two things will not: how Java divides whole numbers, and the order it evaluates things in. Both cause real bugs, so slow down there.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Explain the difference between integer and floating-point division
Apply precedence rules and use parentheses to override them
